title: JBMDL - Jumbotron/Outdoor LED Screens
description: SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE Outdoor LED Video Display Screens and Signal Distribution Support Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst (JB MDL) Open House and Air Show 2027 The 87th Contracting Squadron is seeking information from industry for the purpose of conducting market research for Outdoor LED Video Display Screens and Signal Distribution Support in support of the Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst (JB MDL) Power in the Pines Open House and Air Show 2027. This notice does not obligate the Government to award a contract or any other type of contractual document. THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) NOTICE ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR QUOTATIONS (RFQ). NO SOLICITATION IS AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME. Statement of Characteristics The Government requires contractor-provided outdoor LED video display screens, signal distribution, integration, power generation, setup, operations, maintenance, and teardown support for the Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst (JB MDL) Power in the Pines Open House and Air Show 2027. The requirement supports the in-person spectator audience through the display of Government-furnished live video, Public Affairs content, informational graphics, maps, emergency messaging, and approved sponsor recognition. The selected contractor must furnish and operate four (4) outdoor LED display screens, distribute matching program feeds to designated hospitality chalets, provide complete self-contained primary and backup generator power, and coordinate interfaces with the Government Public Affairs office and the air show sound-system provider. Specifications The Government is seeking sources capable of providing outdoor LED video display screens and signal distribution support meeting the following core characteristics: � Display Screens: Four (4) outdoor daylight-visible LED video display screens with a 16:9 aspect ratio, mounted safely on mobile trailers or engineered support structures, consisting of two (2) screens measuring a minimum of 22 feet wide (positioned at the far ends of the primary spectator area) and two (2) screens measuring a minimum of 16 feet wide (positioned behind show center, behind the Air Boss control tower). � Signal Routing & Distribution: Turnkey video switching, distribution, and routing capability to receive and simultaneously broadcast a primary Government-furnished live video feed across all four screens, accommodate multiple Government content inputs (graphics, slides, prerecorded video), and integrate with the event audio system. � Chalet Program Feeds: Signal distribution and long-run cabling to deliver an HDMI handoff of the main screen program feed to up to six (6) Government-furnished televisions located in sponsorship chalets and VIP hospitality areas. � Emergency Messaging Override: Demonstrated technical capability to immediately interrupt displayed live or recorded content across all four screens to broadcast Government emergency, evacuation, or safety notifications within 30 seconds of notice. � Turnkey Power & Technical Operations: Contractor-furnished primary and backup generators, fuel, power distribution, and dedicated onsite technical support for setup, Thursday testing and operational verification by 2000 local time, full event operations Friday through Sunday (0900�1700), rapid malfunction resolution (15-minute restoration), and complete post-event teardown. � REVISION 16 NOVEMBER 2026: Addition of PWS Section 7, Videographers. For full requirement details, please refer to Attachment 1 - Performance Work Statement (PWS) Outdoor LED Video Display Screens and Signal Distribution Support. Anticipated Period of Performance The anticipated Period of Performance is 21 December 2027 - 31 May 2027. On-site event support at JB MDL, NJ will occur 27 May 2027 through 31 May 2027. � NAICS Code: 532490 - Other Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Rental and Leasing � PSC: W099 - Lease or Rental of Equipment - Miscellaneous Information Requested a) Capability of providing four (4) outdoor daylight-viewable LED display screens (two 22-foot and two 16-foot), multi-input signal routing, chalet TV HDMI distribution, self-sustained generator power, and technical staffing meeting or exceeding the requirements outlined above and in the attached PWS. b) Confirmation that the contractor is available and can perform on-site at JB MDL, NJ during the required dates (27-31 May 2027) within the 21 December 2026 - 31 May 2027 Period of Performance. c) Small business size status of the company under NAICS 532490, including any small business socioeconomic contracting programs (e.g., 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB) that your firm is registered under. Response Guidelines Responses must specifically describe the contractor's capability to fulfill the requirement as stated above and in the attached Performance Work Statement. Companies who wish to respond to this notice should send responses via email no later than 17 November 2026 at 1300 Eastern Time to A1C Theodore Hyatt at theodore.hyatt@us.af.mil and SSgt. Bijan Gloston at bijan.gloston@us.af.mil. Questions Questions regarding this announcement shall be submitted in writing by email to A1C Theodore Hyatt at theodore.hyatt@us.af.mil and SSgt. Bijan Gloston at bijan.gloston@us.af.mil. The Government will not reimburse companies for any costs associated with the submission of their responses. Disclaimer The issuance of this sources sought notice is being done strictly for the purpose of market research. This notice will be the basis for collecting information on capabilities available and is being issued solely for information and planning purposes. All information contained in this notice is preliminary and subject to modification and is in no way binding on the Government. Issuance of this notice will not result in contract award and is not to be construed as any form of commitment on behalf of the Government. The Government will not reimburse companies for any costs associated with the submission of their responses.

description: Auf Beschluss der KMK ist für das Jahr 2028 der erste Ländervergleich zum Erreichen der weiterentwickelten Bildungsstandards für den Primarbereich vorgesehen. description: Das Land Baden-Württemberg, vertreten durch das Ministerium für Wissenschaft, Forschung und Kunst Baden-Württemberg (MWK), möchte ein elektronisches Akten- und Dokumentenmanagementsystem (nachfolgend: E-Akte) für die Bearbeitung von Förderverfahren nach dem Bundesausbildungsförderungsgesetz (BAföG) im Fachverfahren Bafög21 beschaffen und einführen. Zu diesem Zweck schreibt der Auftraggeber eine Rahmenvereinbarung aus, auf deren Grundlage die abrufberechtigten Parteien des Bafög21-Verbunds - das Land Baden-Württemberg, Rheinland-Pfalz und Mecklenburg-Vorpommern - den Auftragnehmer mit der Anbindung und dem Betrieb der E-Akte an das Fachverfahren Bafög21 in den BAföG-Ämtern bei den Studierendenwerken bzw. Hochschulen beauftragen können. Hierdurch können die abrufberechtigten Parteien die Dienstleistung ohne zusätzliches förmliches Vergabeverfahren abrufen. Der Auftraggeber weist darauf hin, dass der Freistaat Sachsen Mitglied des Bafög21-Verbunds ist, aber keine abrufberechtigte Partei der Ausschreibung. Bafög21 bleibt auch nach Anbindung der E-Akte das führende Fachverfahren für die BAföG-Sachbearbeitung. Die E-Akte ergänzt die fachliche Bearbeitung im Fachverfahren Bafög21 durch eine einheitliche, medienbrucharme und nachvollziehbare Aktenführung. Die beteiligten Länder tragen die Kosten der jeweils von ihnen abgerufenen Leistungen des Auftragnehmers selbst. Die beteiligten Länder verfügen über folgende Anzahl an BAföG-Ämtern bei den Studierendenwerken bzw. Hochschulen: - Baden-Württemberg: 8 Studierendenwerke; - Rheinland-Pfalz: 11 Hochschulen; - Mecklenburg-Vorpommern: 2 Studierendenwerke. Der Auftraggeber weist darauf hin, dass die Finanzierung der Anbindung der BAföG-Ämter bei den Studierendenwerken bzw. Hochschulen in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern nicht gesichert ist. Die Rahmenvereinbarung sieht keine Mindestabnahmemenge vor. Der Auftraggeber schätzt die Menge der anzubindenden BAföG-Ämter auf 21. Die Höchstmenge der anzubindenden BAföG-Ämter beträgt 21. Mit Erreichen der Höchstmenge verliert die Rahmenvereinbarung ihre Wirkung.

description: European X-Ray Free-Electron Laser Facility GmbH (European XFEL) is a non-profit limited liability company under German law. It operates the world’s largest X-ray laser, a 3.4-kilometre-long facility from the DESY campus in Hamburg to Schenefeld in Schleswig-Holstein. The laser generates ultrashort X-ray flashes 27,000 times per second, with a peak brilliance a billion times higher than that of the best conventional X-ray sources. The European XFEL is announcing a tender for the development and supply of superconducting undulator (SCU) modules as part of an afterburner project for the Hard X-ray line SASE2. This project will comprise a small series of SCU modules, with one module retained for measurement-system improvements and as a spare. The modules are designed to produce X-ray lasing at photon energies of ≥ 25 keV while operating at an electron beam energy of 16.5 GeV.

description: Procurement of a borehole geophysical logging system for hydrogeological investigations in fractured crystalline bedrock. Laitteiston tulee soveltua mittauksiin syvissä, kaltevissa ja vedellä täyttyneissä tutkimusrei’issä, joiden nimellishalkaisijat ovat 56 mm ja 76 mm. title: Swanley Park Footpath Refurbishment
description: Swanley Town Council is seeking suitably qualified and experienced contractors to undertake the excavation, removal, reconstruction and improvement of two existing footpaths. The project aims to improve accessibility, durability and the overall quality of the footpath network through the installation of wider, fit-for-purpose pathways that meet the requirements of their intended use. The works will comprise the following: Footpath One Footpath One extends approximately 355.4 linear metres and will broadly follow the alignment of the existing footpath. The pathway will be widened to provide a finished width of approximately 2.5 metres, excluding edging. The construction must be suitable for occasional vehicular access, with the appropriate sub-base and construction specification provided to accommodate this requirement. Footpath Two Footpath Two currently measures approximately 29 linear metres and will be extended to approximately 62.3 linear metres. The completed pathway will provide a finished width of approximately 2 metres, excluding edging, improving the provision and usability of the route. Surfacing Options and Construction Requirements The Council is currently exploring a range of surfacing options for the proposed footpaths, including self-binding gravel, tarmac and block paving. Contractors may be required to consider the suitability, durability, maintenance requirements, accessibility and whole-life costs associated with these options to help inform the Council's final decision on the preferred surfacing materials. The appointed contractor will be expected to undertake the necessary excavation and removal of existing footpath materials, prepare the underlying formation, install an appropriate sub-base and construct the new footpaths in accordance with the agreed specification. The works will also include suitable edging, finishing details and any associated reinstatement required to leave the completed pathways in a safe, stable and serviceable condition. All works must be carried out to an appropriate professional standard, with due consideration given to site conditions, public safety, drainage, accessibility and the long-term performance of the finished surfaces. The contractor will be responsible for ensuring that the construction methods and materials used are suitable for the intended use of each footpath. The Council is seeking a cost-effective and durable solution that provides improved pedestrian routes, meets the operational requirements of the site and offers good long-term value for money. Arrange for a site visit if required by contacting (George) gbrooker@swanleytowncouncil.gov.uk Apply by sending your quote to (Ryan) rhayman@swanleytowncouncil.gov.uk

title: Managed Detection and Response (MDR)
description: Med henblik på at beskytte Statens IT (Ordregiver) mod aktuelle og fremtidige cybertrusler anvender Ordregiver en række sikkerhedsteknologier, herunder en Extended Detection and Response (XDR)-platform. XDR-platformen understøtter indsamling, korrelation og analyse af sikkerhedsrelaterede hændelser på tværs af Ordregivers it-miljø med henblik på at beskytte systemer, tjenester og data samt sikre dataenes fortrolighed, integritet og tilgængelighed. Henset hertil udbyder Ordregiver en kontrakt, hvis formål er at understøtte og styrke Ordregivers egen operative it-sikkerhed gennem levering af en Managed Detection and Response (MDR)-tjeneste fra et Security Operations Center (SOC). MDR-tjenesten skal anvende og supplere Ordregivers XDR-platform med døgnbemandet overvågning, analyse, detektion, validering, eskalering og håndtering af sikkerhedshændelser. Tjenesten skal leveres 24 timer i døgnet, 365 dage om året, og bidrage til hurtig identifikation, vurdering og håndtering af cybertrusler og sikkerhedshændelser. Tjenesteydelserne udgør et væsentligt element i Ordregivers fortsatte modnings- og udviklingsproces på cybersikkerhedsområdet med fokus på teknologi, processer, kompetencer og samarbejde på tværs af interne og eksterne interessenter. Med udbuddet ønsker Ordregiver adgang til en professionel MDR-tjeneste, der kan imødekomme Ordregivers høje krav til kvalitet, robusthed og effektivitet, samt en leverandør, der løbende kan indgå i dialog med Ordregiver om udviklingen inden for cybersikkerhed, herunder trusselsbilledet, teknologiske muligheder, automatisering, kompetenceudvikling og løbende forbedringer af sikkerhedsniveauet. Leverandøren skal gennemføre en teknisk, organisatorisk og processuel Transition Ind, der sikrer, at de løbende MDR-ydelser kan leveres fra overgang til driftsfasen. Ordregiver gør opmærksom på, at Ordregiver har indgået kontrakt med to (2) leverandører til varetagelse af Ordregivers eksisterende XDR-platform, som leverandøren skal samarbejde med i forbindelse med Transition Ind. Som led heri skal leverandøren etablere og konfigurere de nødvendige integrationer mellem Ordregivers XDR-platform og øvrige relevante sikkerhedskilder samt leverandørens værktøjer og platforme, der anvendes til kontraktens opfyldelse. Leverandøren skal levere Løbende MDR-ydelser; herunder kontinuerlig overvågning, analyse, korrelation, validering og detektion af alarmer og sikkerhedshændelser. Leverandøren skal foretage triagering og kvalificering af alarmer med henblik på at identificere reelle sikkerhedshændelser samt sikre rettidig eskalering og advisering i overensstemmelse med aftalte processer og serviceniveauer. Disse løbende MDR-ydelser omfatter herunder: • Kontinuerlig SOC-overvågning af sikkerhedsrelaterede hændelser og alarmer. • Analyse, korrelation og kvalificering af hændelser på tværs af relevante datakilder. • Identifikation, detektion og validering af sikkerhedshændelser. • Udarbejdelse, implementering og løbende optimering af detektionsregler, use cases og analysemodeller. • Anvendelse af relevant Threat Intelligence til understøttelse af detektions- og analysearbejdet. • Løbende vurdering af trusselsbilledet og dets relevans for Ordregivers miljø. • Proaktiv identifikation af potentielle sikkerhedshændelser og sikkerhedsrisici, herunder gennem Threat Hunting-aktiviteter. • Eskalering, advisering og rapportering af sikkerhedshændelser i henhold til aftalte processer og serviceniveauer. • Vedligeholdelse af eksisterende integrationer samt etablering af nye integrationer efter behov. • Optimering og videreudvikling af Ordregivers XDR-platform og øvrige sikkerhedsløsninger. • Rådgivning vedrørende udvikling og modning af Ordregivers sikkerhedsorganisation, sikkerhedsprocesser og governance. • Gennemførelse af målrettede Threat Hunting-forløb og analyser af mistænkelige aktiviteter. • Incident Response-bistand ved sikkerhedshændelser efter rekvisition fra Ordregiver, herunder analyse, afgrænsning, håndtering, afhjælpning og genopretning. • Bistand ved større sikkerhedshændelser, cyberkriser og koordination med relevante interessenter. • Sikkerhedsfaglig rådgivning og strategisk sparring om udviklingen inden for cybersikkerhed. Kontrakten omfatter desuden tværgående ydelser, herunder dokumentation, rapportering, governance, kvalitetssikring og informationssikkerhed, der leveres gennem hele kontraktperioden. Endvidere omfatter kontrakten forpligtelser ved kontraktophør (Transition Ud), der skal sikre en kontrolleret, sikker og dokumenteret overdragelse af viden, data, processer, integrationer og øvrige kontraktrelaterede leverancer til Ordregiver eller en efterfølgende leverandør.

title: Consultancy framework agreement for formulation, appraisal and review of Danish development cooperation programmes and projects
description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark (MFA) is in the process of streamlining the management of its development cooperation. Part of this effort concerns the simplification of the procurement process of key consultancy services relating to development cooperation. Consultancy contracts are currently procured individually by the case worker responsible for the programme or project. Case workers are MFA staff from MFA Services at Home and Services Abroad. They are responsible for the procurement process of individual contracts which is often lengthy, and can have implications on programme and project implementation timelines. Moreover, the fragmentation of the process makes it difficult to use the feedback from case workers on the fulfilment of the assignments. This makes it challenging to harvest learning from past performance and ensure a sustained quality of services. It is in this context that the MFA wishes to consolidate the procurement of consultancy services through a framework agreement with multiple contractors. The streamlining of the management of Danish development cooperation entailed a revision of the Danida – Aid Management Guidelines (AMG). This foresees a delegation of key tasks to external consultants, primarily appraisals, and thereby an expected rise in the number of consultancy services to be requested. It is therefore an opportune time to seek a more streamlined procurement process of consultancy services. The AMG’s Bilateral Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/bilateral-cooperation/guidelines-for-programmes-projects-country-strategic-frameworks-and-hard-earmarked-multilat-support) and Financial Management Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/bilateral-cooperation/financial-management) constitute the basic set of procedures for all Danish bilateral development cooperation. The guidelines outline the processes and requirements for the preparation, formulation, quality assurance, approval, implementation, completion and closure of Danish bilateral programmes and projects. The purpose of the framework agreement is to make the MFA procurement of key consultancy services relating to Danish bilateral development programmes and projects more effective and efficient by ensuring quick access to relevant specialists, reducing the procurement time for assignments, and improving the quality of services provided. The objective of the framework agreement is to have a contractual set-up between the MFA and a number of contractors who can provide, upon demand and in a timely manner, the required expertise and service quality for the formulation, appraisal and review of Danish bilateral development programmes and projects. The objective of each assignment and the required outputs will be described in the Terms of Reference, which will be part of the Delivery Contract for the individual assignment. The Framework Agreement solely covers Denmark’s bilateral development cooperation programmes and projects. Therefore, the scope of work of consultancy services solely pertains to Official Development Assistance (ODA) funds. The framework agreement is divided into two lots that reflect the thematic areas and priorities of Denmark’s Strategy for Development Cooperation: Lot 1: Climate, environment, private sector and financing. Lot 2: Governance, fragility, and migration. The framework agreement will require the provision of the following services pertaining to the design and implementation phases of bilateral development cooperation programmes, namely: Formulation of bilateral programmes and projects. This may include preparatory work in the formulation process if and as needed. Appraisal of the design of bilateral programmes and projects as a quality assurance milestone prior to approval. This includes external appraisals led by the consultant and early appraisals of larger or high-risk programmes/projects led by LÆRING. Review of bilateral programmes and projects under implementation. This can span inception, midterm and technical reviews covering the full implementation period of the programme/project as part of the MFA unit’s monitoring and reporting cycle. Reviews do not have the same scope of work, methodology and methods as an evaluation. The MFA’s definition of appraisal, review and evaluation services is aligned with the definitions provided by OECD/DAC (https://one.oecd.org/document/DCD/DAC/EV(2022)2/en/pdf). The content of the services will vary and be defined by the MFA in the specific Terms of Reference for each individual assignment. The following themes and types of services will not be part of the framework agreement: Research and university partnerships. Training programmes and tracer studies. Culture. NGO strategic partnership agreements with the MFA (SPA agreements). Core support to multilateral organisations as described in Danish Organisation Strategies. Strategic Sector Cooperation. Audit assignments. Legal assessments. Monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning (MEAL) unit contracts and multi-year MEAL technical assistance. Evaluations. Tender process consultancies. Hankinnan kohteena olevien rakennusten yhteenlaskettu laajuus on noin 8 500 brm². Purkutyöt koskevat rakennuksia 1, 2 ja 4–9 sekä tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa määriteltyjä muita purettavia rakenteita. Hankintaan sisältyvät lisäksi purku-urakan aikaiset rakennuttamis- ja turvallisuuskoordinaattorin tehtävät, työmaakokoukset, purkutöiden valvonta, dokumentointi sekä vastaanotto- ja luovutusvaiheen tehtävät. Hankinta toteutetaan yhtenä kokonaisuutena. Tarjottavan palvelun tulee sisältää kaikki tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä määritellyt tehtävät ja suoritteet. Hankinnan tarkempi sisältö, laajuus, aikataulu, hinnoitteluperusteet ja muut ehdot on esitetty tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa ja niiden liitteissä.,
